findings.evidence: Initial Lighthouse mobile audit reported label-content-name-mismatch for the visible “Menu” button whose accessible name was “Toggle navigation”.
The final Cloud Run action opened a page whose first viewport was branded for the Google for Startups challenge and prioritized HUT rather than the Apple-first Evidence OS.
The six-slide tour changed from Apple on slides 1 and 3 to “One HUT TripCode…” on slide 4 without identifying HUT as a second proof.
Initial root-page audit detected competition language, no Apple reference, and a HUT-first product hierarchy at desktop and mobile widths.
Initial demo-page audit detected competition language, no Apple reference, delayed content reveals, and a sparse first viewport.
Initial 390px mobile capture expanded to 469px and clipped the operator header, explanatory copy, and fields while root overflow was suppressed.
